triplet: No humans allowed, unless tasty.
A logical argument is grounds for a mistrial.
The court will hear the animals.
The White Rabbit, late for a very important date; possibly a hallucination, melting watch.
The Caterpillar, demands you explain who you are; rejects your answer. Hookah haze, mushroom.
The Cheshire Cat, we're all mad here; I'm just honest about it. Gaslight, a fading grin.
The Mad Hatter, murdered time; eternal 6:00 PM, a weasel, top hat and spilling tea.
The March Hare, aggressive hospitality; takes best butter very seriously, frantic teapot.
The Dormouse, breathing while sleeping is the same as sleeping while breathing. Narcolepsy.
The Queen of Hearts, verdict first, sentence later. Off with their heads; a heart scepter.
The King of Hearts, pardons everyone when the Queen isn't looking, crown over his eyes.
The Duchess, everything has a moral, if you can find it; usually involves pepper and piglet.
The Visitor (The Anomaly), a cryptid ape changes size rapidly; Dodo, pigeon, serpent!
The Rabbit Hole, gravity optional; discarded cards fall, cupboards, clocks, marmalade jar.
The Pool of Tears, salty communication while holding your nose; Dodo and mouse in waves.
The Hall of Doors, locked out until you solve a riddle; golden key on the glass table.
The Duchess' Kitchen, pepper sneeze before speaking; flying pans, pepper smoke, Cheshire grin.
The Mad Tea Party, time loop, repeat the previous player's last sentence; empty chairs.
The Rose Garden, cover up, overwrite a Scene; white roses dripping red paint, soldiers brush.
The Croquet Ground, live ammo; Tools might run away, flamingo mallets and hedgehog balls.
The High Tribunal, kangaroo court; logic forbidden, guinea pig suppressed; Blödsinn!
The Mock Turtle's Rock, melancholy, a deep heavy sigh; weeping turtle on sea rock.
Suspicious Cake, grow; the Actor becomes Giant and can intimidate the King. Eat me.
Unknown Bottle, shrink; Actor becomes Micro, hides inside other cards. Drink me.
The Mushroom, mutation; heads grow, tails shrink, edge a neck like a serpent; fly agaric.
The Vorpal Flamingo, blunt force; strike a conversation, change topic; grumpy flamingo.
The Squeaky Slate-Pencil, annoyance; force writing instead of speaking. SCREECH.
The Treacle Well, sticky trap; the Actor cannot leave the Scene; teapot and bowler stuck.
Quest: Paint the Roses Red, conceal a mistake before the Queen arrives; risk decapitation.
Quest: Find the Gloves, help the White Rabbit find accessories; risk mistaken for Mary Ann.
Quest: Solve the Riddle, why is a raven like a writing desk? No answer, infinite loop.
Quest: Who Stole the Tarts?, prove innocence or guilt; Knave guilty, evidence makes no sense.
Quest: Give Evidence, recite a poem correctly; words come out wrong. Twinkle, little bat.

You have the cards. Wake up.
